brief: Calculate a claim’s out-of-pocket cost under a stated deductible and coverage limit.

objective.observable_action: Calculate a claim’s out-of-pocket cost under a stated deductible and coverage limit.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A covered claim may leave a deductible and amounts above the payout cap; calculate both with fictional local currency.
instruction.misconception: The deductible is the only possible retained cost even when the insurer payout is capped.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.
